player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Checkers as {color}.
Make your move in chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Basic rules:
  • Move diagonally forward by 1 if empty.
  • Capture by jumping over an opponent piece.
  • A piece is Kinged if it reaches the opposite end.
